text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan schemed to make Vodka and 
Daiwa Scarlet even more conscious of each 
other. As a result, the two—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They decided to settle the score at the 
Oka Sho, which Aston Machan is scheduled 
to run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If the two of them clash, it's bound to 
cause a huge stir. Aston Machan aims to 
seize victory there and steal the 
spotlight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, she threw herself into training 
with extra fervor. To set the stage for a 
grand showdown in the Oka Sho, first she 
needed to make her mark in the Fillies' 
Revue!
